pov: first-person retrospective narrator / younger experiencing self
purpose: Bring the idealized errand into contact with the nearly closed commercial bazaar and end in self-revaluation.
entry_state: The boy has arrived at Araby late, still oriented toward buying a gift.
desire: Find something worth buying before the bazaar closes.
conflict: The bazaar is darkening and ordinary commercial indifference offers no support for the meaning he projected onto the errand.
turn: He abandons the purchase and experiences a painful self-recognition as the hall goes dark.
exit_state: The gift errand is abandoned; the boy's understanding of his own motive has shifted.
forbidden_moves: Do not reduce the final image and self-recognition to a binary fact whose truth exhausts the passage's literary effect.
style_constraints: Preserve the relation between commercial anticlimax, darkness, and self-recognition without claiming a single typed interpretation is exhaustive.
